Welcome to ULaMDyn’s documentation!¶

ULaMDyn is a python-based toolkit for data analysis of (nonadiabatic) molecular dynamics (MD) simulations build on top of the Pandas and Scikit-Learn framework. It provides a set of classes and methods to perform the preprocessing, statistical, and unsupervised learning analysis of MD trajectories data generated by the Newton-X program. ULaMDyn was designed to automate the search and discovery of hidden patterns in high-dimensional molecular data sets, thereby enhancing the interpretability and understanding of nonadiabatic dynamics simulations.

Features¶

  • Statistical analysis:

    • Perform a descriptive statistics by computing the median, mean and standard deviation over all available MD trajectories.

    • The bootstrap algorithm can be used to determine the uncertainty of molecular properties within a given confidence level.

  • For dimensionality reduction:

    • Principal Component Analysis (PCA).

    • Kernel Principal Component Analysis (KPCA).

    • Isometric Mapping.

    • t-distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (TSNE).

  • To identify patterns in MD trajectories data:

    • K-Means clustering.

    • Hierarchical agglomerative clustering.

    • Spectral clustering.

Installation:¶

ULaMDyn is distributed as a python package and it can be installed into the local python environment together with the required external libraries using the setup.py script as described below:

$ pip install -r requirements.txt
$ python setup.py install
Note: Here is a list of external libraries that will be installed with ULaMDyn:

  • numpy

  • pandas (modin will be used if installed manually)

  • rmsd

  • h5py

  • joblib

  • scikit-learn
